# Case Configuration Fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic G1 `case.json` examples for `SWE-DAT-CFG-WP1`.
They are not authoritative Tohoku, Kamaishi, Sendai or production
configurations.

The logical dataset IDs and corridor dimensions are parser and validation
fixtures only. Dataset manifest content, geospatial provenance and generated
artefact lineage belong to downstream data/geospatial Work Packages.
